tei:div.tei:p: "$ (175)༄༅// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu til+li pa'i gdams pa bzhugs so/// /

(176)༄༅// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī/ chos skor dgu'i gdams pa 'di la gnyis las/ dang po lo rgyus cung zad dang bcas te brgyud rim bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug til+li pas/ o rgyan gan+dho la'i gtsug lag khang du byon te/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro la snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag nor bu skor gsum rdzogs par thob nas mi yul du 'byon par chas pa la/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzhugs par gsol ba btab rung ma gnang bar/ tshes bcu la 'byon par chas pa la/ ye shes mkha' 'gros skyel chos ni// sku ni mi snang hūm̐ gi sgra// mchog tu snyan zhing yid 'phrog pas// mkha' la cer gyis bltas pa las// lha dang ḍā ki sprin ltar 'thibs// dpa' bo dpa' mo glog ltar 'khyugs// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs// 'dzin mkhan med pas nam mkha' gang*// 'ja' 'od dkyil 'khor dbus nyid nas// 'od zer hūm̐ yig mthing nag la// mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul mthong bas// slob dpon chen po til+li pas// thal sbyar gsol ba btab pa las// ngo bo ye shes mkha' 'gro (177)ma// rnam pa hūm̐ yig mthing nag las// tshangs dbyangs rang sgra 'di skad thos// kyai ho bu nyon rnal 'byor pa// smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shig /dam tshig rang sems me long ltos// spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'des// rig pa ye shes sgron me ltos// rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo skor// ro snyoms phyi yi me long ltos// rang grol phyag rgya chen po sgoms// bde chen gsung gi rin chen zungs// bcom ldan lus med mkha' 'gro ma// sangs rgyas ḍā kis des gsungs tshe// rnal 'byor dbang phyug tai lo yis// de don rgyas par zhu phyir du// slar yang thal sbyar gsol btab pas// lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas// chos skor dgu yi tshig don rnams// ma lus rgyas par gsung pa ni// smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shig

/zhes sogs kyi tshig don rnams man ngag gis bkrol te rgyas par gsung pa las/ tai lo pas dus de nyid du yi ger bkod nas// mi yul du 'byon tshe/ sgyu ma lus kyi gan+dho lar// lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang bcug te// brjod du med pa'i lcags (178)bcug nas// 'od gsal sems kyi bya 'phur 'gro// ces gsungs nas rdzu 'phrul gyi gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par byon te/ 'gro don mdzad tshe thugs sras grub thob rnams kyis o rgyan la mkha' 'gro ma las gsan pa'i chos rnams nan gyis zhus pas ma gnang bar/ paṇa chen nā ro pa la snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa bka' rgyas btab te gnang nas gnas lung bstan/ chos skor dgu po 'di yang mkha' 'gro la dngos su gsan pa yin gsungs/ nā ro pa sogs thugs sras 'ga' la gnang*/ nā ro pas ti phu pa sogs thugs sras 'ga' la gnang*/ paṇa chen nā ros te lo'i lung bstan ltar sgra sgyur mar pa la bka' rgyas btab nas gnang ste/ rje btsun mi la lung bstan zhing*/ chos skor dgu las bzhi gnang zhing thob nas/ rig pa ye shes sgron me/ rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo// bde chen gsung gi rin chen/ ro snyoms phyi yi me long*/ rang grol phyag rgya chen po rnams ma thob pa sgra sgyur mar bas rje btsun mi la la longs shig ces bka' gnang ba las/ rje btsun nyams len gyis thugs tshims nas rgya gar la byon pa ma byung ba la/ chos skor dgu zhu bar ras chung ba brdzangs/ ras chung pas kyang ti phu gsang sngags sdong po la chos skor dgu po tshang bar zhus te bod du spyan drangs nas/ snyan brgyud kyi cha lag tu chos skor dgu'i gdams pa 'di ma gnang ba med cing*/ snyan brgyud ma gnang bar 'di rang gnang ba yang 'ga' re yod/ ras chung pas khyung tshang ba la snyan brgyud dang bcas pa gnang*/ khyung tshang bas kyang gong ltar gnyis ka gnang ba dang*/ 'di rang gnang ba dang gnyis yod pa las thugs sras grub thob rnams gsum la gnyis ka gnang zhing*/

de gsum ka la zhang lo ts+tsha bas zhus pa las dmar som chos dgu la shin tu 'dris par dgongs nas nan tan zhus dag dang bcas zhus shing gnang bar gda'/ de man bdag gi pha mnyam med sha ba ra chen po dang bdag gi bar la snyan brgyud kyi cha lag tu chos skor dgu po 'di ma (179)gnang ba med pas brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med mkha' 'gro/ til+li shes rab bzang po/ mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ khyung tshang ye shes bla ma/ dmar sgom tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ zhang lo grub pa dpal bzang*/ 'gro mgon dhā ra shrī/ byang sems bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ma gcig kun ldan ras ma/ mkhas btsun gzi brjid rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab/ ba btang ri khrod ras chen gzhon nu dpal ldan/ long ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ mnyam med rab 'byams chos rje/ des bdag du ma'i ming can la'o// gnyis pa gdams pa dngos bshad pa ni/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang*// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shigs// zhes pa'i don la/ maṇ+ḍal bsham pa dang*/ lam du zhugs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang gsum mo// dang po maṇ+ḍal bsham pa ni/ tshul dang mthun pa'i stegs bu'i steng du/ rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal bsham/ de'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ gcig bzhengs nas bzhugs/ de'i steng du bde mchog yab yum mam/ shākya thub kyi thang sku gnyis bkram/ de'i mthar pū tsa lnga bshams te/ sha mar zan chang khur ba dang lnga'o// gnyis pa lam du 'jug pa la gsum gyi dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ chos spyi dang mthun pa'i skyabs 'gro bya/ yid kyis bla ma dkon mchog min pa skyabs mgon gzhan na yod re shi snyam pa'i zhe mna' bskyal lo// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ smon 'jug gnyis kha tshang ba'i sems bskyed blo stobs bskyed pas blang ba spyi dang mthun la/

bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa las/ rang gi zhi bde sgrub re shi snyam pa'i zhe mna' bskyal lo// (180)gsum pa sdom pa blang ba la gnyis las dang po rten bsams nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs te pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba dbus kyi pad+ma'i steng du/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ de'i steng ngo bo lus med mkha' 'gro yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par bsams/ de'i steng du bla ma shākya thub pa'am/ bde mchog yab yum gyi ngo bor bsam/ de'i steng du brgyud pa rnams rim par bsam/ de'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma la dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ de rnams la mchod pa ni/ dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul te/ phyi'i pū tsa sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bul/ nang gi mchod pa tshogs kyi yo byad lnga/ ga na tsakra pū dza hoḥzhes pas dbul/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa'i bdag nyid mchod pa'i lha mo yid du 'ong ba zhig tu sprul/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang bcas pa rnams la dbul la/ rab tu dges shing rol nas mnyes par bsam mo// gnyis pa sdom pa blang ba dngos ni/ thun mong theg chen spyi dang mthun par bya/ khyad par rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma bde mchog yab yum du bzhugs pa la me tog dor/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bum dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros bdag la sogs pa'i lus la thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa dkar sangs kyis dag par bsam/ yang bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thig le dkar dmar byang chub kyi sems nar gyis bab nas bdag gi ngag nas mar zhugs pas lus thig les mer gyis gang bar bsam/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag par gyur/

yang bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol (181)pa btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gcig byung nas bdag la phog pas bdag gi lus 'di lha mo mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba zhig tu gyur nas/ bla ma bde mchog gi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i sku la 'khril nas/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba byas nyams bde stong gi ngang du phril gyis 'bar nas yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi pad+ma'i steng gi rten de rnams kyis thugs rjes bdag la tser gyis gzigs te/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas bdag la sib kyis thim par bsam/ nyams spros bral lhag song bar bsam/ de ni dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas tshogs la rol lo// / na mo rat+na gu ru/ de nas yang lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// dam tshig rang sems me long ltos// zhes gsungs pa'i don la gsum gyi dang po/ dam tshig la bzhi ste/ bum dbang gi dam tshig /gsang dbang gi dam tshig /shes rab ye shes kyi dang dbang bzhi pa'o// de re re la yang drug drug ste/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig dang*/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ mi 'bral ba dang dgos pa'o// bum dbang gi mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig ni lha sku'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'o// rjes kyi dam tshig ni spyod lam bzhi kar tha mal du ma song bar/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gnas pa la longs spyod pa'o// bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i ril bu brten pa'o// des lha dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'o// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni rtsa ba bcu bzhi yan lag brgyad dang bcas pa bsrung ba'o// mi 'bral bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sku'i rten thang sku/ gsung gi rten ḍā ma ru/ thugs kyi rten rdo rje dril bu rtag tu brten pa'o// dam tshig bsrung ba'i dgos pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku thob pa'o// gsang dbang la yang (182)spyi don drug las/

gsang dbang gi mnyam bzhag ni/ steng sgo gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rtsa rlung yengs med du bsgom pa'o// rjes thob ni rtsa rlung sgom pa'i nyams spyod lam bzhi kar bde gsal stong pa'i nyams yengs med du bskyang ba'o// bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'dod yon lnga la spyod pa'i tshe gsal stong gnyis med du longs spyod pa'o// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thig le nyams par byed pa'i zas dang spyod lam thams cad srung ba'o// mi 'bral bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ srog rtsol gyi rlung 'dzin pa la le lor ma shor bar bya'o// ma yengs tsam du bskyang ngo*// dgos pa ni chos sku thob pa'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dam tshig drug ste/ mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig ni las kyi phyag rgya ma brten cing thig le'i dgongs pa la brtson par bya'o// rjes thob du spyod lam bzhi ji ltar spyod kyang*/ nyams bde stong gi ngang las ma g.yos par bya'o// bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod kyang*/ rnam pa lha'i ngo bos zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ nyams bde stong gi ngang la bza'o// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya ma dang mi 'bral zhing*/ dus ma yin pa'i thig le srog bzhin du bsrung*/ mi 'bral bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyag rgya ma'i gzugs mthong ba dang*/ skad thos tsam du mi 'bral bar bya'o// dgos pa ni longs sku thob pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig la yang drug las/ mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig ni gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag pa'o// rjes thob ni spyod lam bzhi ji ltar spyod kyang rang byung rang shar skye med spros bral du lhag lhag shes pa'o// bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni 'dod yon lnga gang la spyod kyang zhen 'dzin med pa/ skye ba med pa'i ngo bor lhag lhag shes par bya'o// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam (183)tshig ni dngos po'i chos thams cad la bden pa dang*/

rtag pa dang*/ rang rgyud pa'i blo spang ngo*// mi 'bral bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni dus thams cad du gnas lugs kyi ngang las ma yengs pa'o// dgos pa ni ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'o// gnyis pa rang sems ni me long g.yas ma gos pa lta bu/ sems nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa zhig dgos pas de bzhin du bslab cing*/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes par bya'o// gsum pa me long lta ba ni/ rang rgyud la nyes ltung gi dri mas gos ma gos bltas pa/ gos na me long g.yas sgrib pa ltar rang sems nyon mongs pas bsgribs pa yin pas/ me long phyi ba ltar dam tshig nyams chags byung 'dug na/ sngar byas kyi nyes pa la 'gyod sems dug 'thung ba lta bu dang*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyams pa'i sdom sems dang lan nges kyi skong bshags drag po bya zhing*/ phyin chad rang gis rang la ma khrel bar nyes ltung gis nam yang ma gos par bsrung ba la 'bad par bya'o// nyams chags gzhi med rang sar grol na rtogs pa mchog gi dam tshig thob pa yin no// / na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// ces pa'i don/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la bzhi ste/ tshogs spyod/ rig spyod/ gsang spyod/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa'o// spyod pa'i dus la bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin mthu brtan par byed pa'i dus/ bogs 'byin pa'i dus/ rkyen ngan dang bsre ba'i dus/ yul lam du slong ba'i dus te de dag ni dbang bzhi'i nyams len gyis dus dang sbyor/ spyod pa la yang bzhi ste/ bum dbang gi spyod pa/ gsang dbang gi spyod pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi spyod pa/ dbang bzhi ba'i spyod pa'o// de rnams gung sbyar nas/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa'i spyod (184)lugs bstan pa ni/ dang po bum dbang gi don bskyed rim la gom 'dris brtan par bya phyir/

spyod lam thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar bya zhing*/ 'dod yon gang la longs spyod kyang tshogs su rol bar bya'o// gsang dbang gi don rig sbyor bya ste/ rdzogs rim rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bsgom par bya zhing*/ gnyis su med pa'i don phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob nas lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la bogs dbyung ba'i phyir/ gsang spyod byas te/ nags tshal dang*/ dur khrod/ shing gcig la sogs pa'i dben pa'i gnas su las kyi phyag rgya mtshan ldan khrid do// las rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis nges shes bskyed/ zab mo'i dbang bskur/ gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag btab la/ shin tu gsang ba'i sgo nas/ bde chen gsung gi rin chen gyi las rgya ltar nyams su blang ngo*// tshig dbang gi don phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa bya ste/ grong dang*/ dur khrod/ tshang 'dus dang*/ kun dga' ra ba/ rgyal po'i pho brang la sogs chags sdang skye ba'i yul sna tshogs su rgyu zhing*/ bde sdug gi ro thams cad chos nyid du mnyam mo// des skyon thams cad chod do// rkyen bzang ngan med par lam du bslangs/ spang blang med par grogs su 'gyur ro// de'i tshe rang gi bya ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas/ gzhan don du ci 'gro 'ba' zhig bya ste/ gang du 'dug kyang gzhal yas khang*/ su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha/ las ji ltar byas kyang byang chub lam yin pas na/ phyogs su lhung ba'i spyod pa las rnam par rgyal nas/ ci bde ba'i spyod pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'o// / na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'di// zhes pa'i don dam (185)rdzas ni dbang bzhi'i dam rdzas te/ lam phyag rgya bzhi'i dus su brten pa'o// de la bum dbang gi dam rdzas ni/ bskyed rim lha sgom pa'i dus su brten pa ste/

yi dam gang yin gyi thang sku dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan brten pa ste/ de yang rab gnas dang ldan pa gal che'o// gsang ba'i dbang gi dam rdzas ni/ rdzogs rim rlung sgom pa'i dus su brten pa ste/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga brten pa'o// de'ang byin gyis ma brlabs na khyi phag dang 'dra bas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i ril bu brten no// de lta bur byin gyis brlabs pa'i thabs ni/ tshul dang mthun pa'i maṇ+ḍal sin+dhu ra dang chang gis dmar por byugs la/ mañdzi'i khar thod pa dum bu gcig pa'am lnga pa dgod/ de'i dbus su yab kyi byang sems dkar po cong zhis gta' byas pa'i ril bu/ shar du dri chen a ru ras gta' byas pa'i ril bu/ lhor sha chen la tsan+dan gyis gta' byas pa'i ril bu/ nub du yum gyi rak+ta sin+dhu ras gta' byas pa'i ril bu/ byang du dri chu gu gul dkar pos gta' byas pa'i ril bu rnams bzhag cing*/ de rnams kyi bar du 'bras bu gsum/ tsha ba gsum/ bzang po drug cung zad re bzhag go /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar gtor ma dang*/ chang bu de dang rak+ta dang sna lnga'i mchod pa dang*/ tshogs rnams bshams la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ting 'dzin du zhugs nas/ gu gul gyis dam rdzas la bdug cing*/ srung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad de/ hūm̐ bzhi pas bgegs bskrad do// de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshangs ba'i gnas bzhi'i mthar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom nas bdun rnam dag gis tshogs bsags shing*/ dbang bzhi zhus nas/ rang yi dam gang yin pa'i mngon rtogs bsgoms la/ bsnyen pa cung zhig bskyal lo// de nas bhan+dha'i nang gi bdud rtsi lnga'i steng du sha lnga bsnan te/ dbus su mi/ shar du ba glang*/ (186)lhor khyi/ nub tu rta/ byang du glang po che'i sha'o// de'i steng du sbyang bya'i yi ge bkod de/ na shu/ go bi/ ku ma/ da ra/ ha mu de dag gi steng du phyogs kyi rim pa gong ltar la/ sbyang byed kyi yi ge bkod de/

hūm̐ mūm̐/ oṃ lām̐/ swā mām̐ āḥpām̐ ha tām̐/ rnams dgod la/ rang yi dam lha yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs la/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ yab yum gyi khams lnga'i dwangs ma thig le byang sems zhu nas/ yum gyi mkha' la babs te slar yab kyi rdo rjes drangs nas rtsa dbu mar zhugs/ tshangs bug nas 'phros/ 'od zer des rigs lnga yab yum gyi thugs dam bskul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba byas/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i mkha' sgo nas byang sems dkar dmar du shar gyis babs nas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i yig 'bru rnams la phog /yig 'bru 'od du zhu nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la thim pas/ bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa mer gyis gyur par bsam mo// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā kuṇ+ḍa li ma hā pañtsa muṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes thun re re la stong stong bzla'o// thun bzhir nyams su blang*/ thun tha ma la gtor ma btang zhing tshogs bya'o// de ltar thun bzhir nyams su blangs te/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma kho na bzhin bya'o// de la rtags bdud rtsi lnga la du ba 'thul ba'am/ dri zhim po 'byung ngo*// de tsa na dngos grub blangs phyir sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su gtugs te/ rdzas de rnams bsdus nas chang dang sbyar te ril bu sran ma tsam byas la lcags kyi snod du bcangs/ de lus la brten na lha dang mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du/ khong du zos na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes zhing rtsa rlung las su rung bar 'gyur ro// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dam rdzas phyag rgya mtshan ldan bsten (187)zhing*/ gal te dngos su bsten par ma nus na/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten cing*/ las kyi phyag rgya yang spang blo ma skye ba re bya'o// dbang bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po'i dam rdzas su/ bla ma'i gdams ngag /gnas lugs kyi dran pa ma yengs bar bsten par bya'o// /

na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// rig pa ye shes sgron me bltams// zhes pa'i don la gsum ste/ gzhi rig dang*/ lam rig dang*/ 'bras bu'i rig pa'o// gzhi rig pa ni/ dbang bzhi'i gdams pa ste/ rgyu sems can gyi dus na/ 'khrul par jag ma'i snang ba 'di ka ye nas sku dang ye shes kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin kyang*/ de ltar ngo ma shes pa la/ dbang bzhi'i dus su smin cing rig par byas te/ bum dbang gi dus su lhar ngo sprad te/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha dang lha mo/ phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor ngo sprad pas/ lus tha mal gyi ngo bo las grol nas lha'i skur rig go /gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa las log nas/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum/ yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor rig par byas nas/ gtum mo'i rdzogs rim rlung lam du byed/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags rang rgyud pa'i rtog pa las log nas/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su rig cing ngo sprad par byas nas/ rdzogs rim rtsa lam du byed do// dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sems tha mal gyi rtog pa nyon mongs pa rang rgyud par 'dzin pa de las log nas rig pa dang stong pa gnyis su med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bor rig ste/ 'khrul pa rang sar grol nas/ dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba la longs spyod par byed do// des na 'khor ba bya ba ye nas ma grub kyang*/ skyes bus log par rtog pas sdug (188)bsngal nyams su myong ba la bla mas ngo sprad pas/ yin lugs bzhin rig pa'o// / na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo bskor// ces pa'i don ni/ spyir lus mgo mjug na rtsa nyi khri chig stong*/ de las bsdus pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis/

de las bsdus pa'i rtsa brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de las bsdus pa'i rtsa gtso mo gsum mo// de yang rtsa gdan gnas pa na rlung gnas/ rlung gang na gnas pa na thig le gnas/ thig le gang na gnas pa na spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnas so// de ltar rtsa thams cad drwa ba ltar 'brel zhing*/ nus pa re'u mig so sor gnas so// de yang rtsa las su rung ba byed pa la rlung dgos la/ rlung gi las la dbye ba bdun gnas te/ bum pa can dang*/ zhabs tshags can dang*/ dpyang thag can dang*/ mda' ltar 'phang dang*/ re'u mig can dang*/ 'khor lo can dang*/ srog shing can no// de yang bum pa can gyis 'og rlung 'dzin pas thig le 'dzin pa dang*/ drod spor ba'i las byed do// zhabs tshags can gyis rlung nad sel ba dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i dus su thig le gtong ba'i las byed do// dpyang thag can gyis gsang ba'i gnas nas thig le gyen la sdom pa'i las byed do// de ni yi ge hūm̐ lus gnad bcas pas drag tu 'then pa'o// mda' ltar 'phang pas steng 'og gi rlung drag tu gcun nas/ thig le rtsa mig tu mda' ltar 'phen pa ste/ thig le 'grem pa'i las byed do// re'u mig can gyis tsha ba'i nad sel ba ste/ lus gang na ba'i sar bug pa zang thal bsam nas/ steng gi rlung bcud la bor bas/ nad khrag ngan bzhin du rgyang rgyang thon par bsam mo// 'khor lo can gyis grang ba'i nad la pho ba'i nang du steng 'og gi rlung bcud la bor nas/ pho ba'i rlung steng 'og (189)drag po bsgoms pas/ thang stong la rlung byung nas sbur ma gtor ba bzhin du/ nad thams cad bsdus dkrugs gtor nas pho ba stong sangs kyis song bar bsam la/ srog shing can ni/ rlung gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa ste/ rlung thams cad rtsa dbu ma'i nang du chud par byed pa'o// des ni gsal stong gi nyams nam mkha' lta bur 'char ro// de la brten nas phyag rgya chen po gshis ma bcos pa'i don rtogs par 'gyur ro// /

na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// ro snyoms phyi yi me long ltos// zhes pa'i don ni/ spyir chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ chos can snang ba'i rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba/ stong pa'i rang rtsal rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin par ma shes par/ dngos po rang rgyud par bzung nas/ de la chags sdang skyes/ des las bsags nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pas/ 'dir de las log nas/ chos can yul rnam pa sna tshogs su shar ba dang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis spros bral gnyis snang stong dbyer med sgyu ma lta bur ro mnyam pas/ dngos po'i bden 'dzin zhig nas las mi gsog pa'i phyir/ 'khor bar 'khyams don med do// de ro ji ltar snyoms pa gsum gyi dang po tshogs drug yul gyi 'khrul snang*/ snang stong zhen med du ro snyoms pa ni/ da lta dbang po sgo lnga'i yul na/ gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i yul rnam pa sna tshogs su shar yang*/ phyi rol na grub pa gcig kyang med pas/ de rmi lam gyi ltas mo ltar/ rang gi sems 'khrul pa'i gzugs brnyan du thag bcad/ des gzung bar rang bzhin med par shes/ nang shes pa la 'gyu byed kyi rtog pa sna tshogs su shar yang*/ sems nyid stong pa la dngos po dang ngos bzung ba med/ rtog pa la (190)dngos po dang ngos bzung med/ rtog pa thams cad sems dwangs pa yul gyi gzugs brnyan du shar ba yin/ me long la za 'og gi gur khyim 'char ba ltar/ stong pa'i ri mo la dpyad des 'dzin pa thams cad spros pa dang bral bar shes/ des gzung 'dzin gyi skur gtibs pas/ 'khor ba'i rmang rdo zhig nas/ las kyis kha bsgyur du med do// gnyis pa bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul snang rig stong rten 'brel du ro snyoms pa ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad bden par grub pa med kyang*/ rang rig 'khrul pa'i snang ba la bag chags kyi ling btab/

'khor ba brgyud mar 'khor ba yin pas/ 'dir gti mug ye shes su grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi gdams pa nyams su blangs te/ dang po nyin bar gyi snang ba 'di thams cad kyang rmi lam yin nges snyam du dran pas bzung*/ gnyid nyal khar rmi lam du shes par bya/ ngo shes nas kyang rang gi dge sbyor la gnas par bya snyams du 'dun pa drag po lan mang du btang la/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor thig le dmar po sran ma tsam la sems gtad la nyal lo// de nas gnyid log pa dang rmi lam rmi ba'i tshe/ 'di rmi lam yin nges snyam du ngo shes pas rang 'khrul ngos zin/ nyin bar gyi snang ba la bden 'dzin 'jig go /rang lam gang la gnas pa'i dge sbyor gsal thebs pas las kyi rgyun pa la/ des bar do la the tshom mi za'o// gsum pa bar do las kyi 'khrul snang chos sku 'od gsal du ro snyoms pa ni/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe bla ma la gsol ba btab cing*/ bar do la bar do ngo shes par bya snyam du 'dun pa drag po btang*/ phyi'i dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad tsam gyi bar der/ 'gro ba kun la chos sku 'od gsal rjen par 'char/ 'di la 'od gsal goms pa rnams kyis/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngos zin nas de nyid (191)du sangs rgya'o// 'di la ma goms pa rnams kyis ngos ma zin pas nang dbugs shor ba dang bar do'i 'khrul snang 'char ste/ tho skor gyi mi 'dus pa dang*/ lto skal chad/ mal sa phyags/ phung po dor/ shi bar ngo shes 'ong*/ de'i dus su 'di bar dor 'dug snyam nas bla ma dang gdams ngag dran nas/ lam 'od gsal la gsal ba'i nyams dran pas 'bras bu mngon du byed te/ bskyed rim la goms pa yin te/ yi dam gang yin gyi skur sangs rgya'o// rdzogs rim nyams su blangs pa yin na/ bar do 'od kyi lus kyis mkha' spyod du 'gro/ phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pa zhig yin na yum chos kyi dbyings la rig pa'i ye shes thim nas chos skur grol bar 'gyur ro/// /

na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// rang grol phyag rgya chen po bsgom// zhes pa'i don/ shes bya gshis kyi 'dug tshul/ sems nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis su med par gnas pa yin kyang*/ stong pa'i rtsal rig par shar/ rig pa'i rtsal snang bar shar/ rang snang la rang 'khrul nas/ yul la dngos por bzung*/ rang rig rang ngo ma shes pas/ rang sems 'dzin par shar/ gzung 'dzin gyis 'khor ba'i rmang rdor bcug /sdug bsngal gra rgyas pa thags pa sbrul du 'khrul ba lta bu ste/ la las spong*/ la las spyod/ la las bsgyur kyang*/ yin lugs kyi steng du ma phebs pas/ 'khrul ba rang sar grol bar ma nus te// nad dang dpyad 'dzol ba lta bu yin no// da res 'dir 'khrul pa rang sar grol bar byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i don yin no// 'di la gdams pa'i gnad gsum gyi dang po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bcad pa ni/ bde ba'i gdan la ci bde bar 'dug ste/ rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ (192)spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad phyi rol dang don la sogs pa grub pa med de/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba rmi lam gang la thag rbad kyis bcad do// 'o na sems bya ba gcig yod dam snyam na/ sems kyang dran tsam/ rig tsam/ btags pa tsam yin te/ yang dag tu ma grub par shes par bya/ de yang sems kyis sems la bltas pas dbang po drug gi yul las 'das zhing*/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bur shes par bya'o// gnyis pa 'khrul snang gi yal ga bregs pa ni/ de ltar gzung 'dzin gnyis ma grub par shes pa de'i ngang la blta bya lta byed dam/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi shes pa thams cad dang bral te/ sems ma bcos par rang babs su lhan ne 'jog pa'o// gsum pa rig pa dbyings su bstim pa ni/

sems rang sar mi gnas par/ yul la rtog pa 'phro ba'i dus su/ yul rtog de dag kyang mi dgag /rang rgyud par yang mi bzung*/ rjes su yang mi 'dzin par/ dran pa'i mel tshes yul rtog de nyid kyi rang bzhin la cer cer bltas pas/ smig rgyu'i 'khrul pa bdas pas gtor ba ltar/ rang bzhin med par rjen ne grol nas 'gro'o// don de lta bu la yang nas yang du goms par byas pas/ 'khrul pa thams cad rang sar grol ba ni chab rom chur zhu zhing thim pa bzhin no/// / na mo rat+na gu ru/ lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos skor dgu yi gdams pa las// bde chen gsung gi rin chen zung*// zhes pa'i don/ lus kyi rtsa sa ya phrag bcu gsum 'dus pa'i bcud// thig le byang chub kyi sems kun+dha lta bu'o// de la ci'i phyir bde chen zhes bya na/ rtsa nus ldan gyi steng du thig le byang chub kyi sems phebs nas/ thabs dang mi ldan pa la zag bcas kyi bde ba skye ba la/ thabs dang ldan pa la zag med kyi bde ba chen (193)po skye ba'i phyir bde chen no// gsung gces pa na rlung ngo*// de yang thig le 'phen sdud byed pa rlung gi las so// rin chen ji ltar 'dod pa 'byung ba ste/ thabs dang mi ldan pa'i tha mal pa rnams kyis nyon mongs pa rang rgyud pa'i bde ba la spyad pas/ 'khor ba'i chos 'grub par byed la/ thabs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dbab gzung zlog dang 'grem pa'i gnad kyis/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba la longs spyad pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba la longs spyod pa'o// zung zhes pa ni/ thig le bsrung ba'i don de/ khams lnga'i dwangs ma zhu ba'i thig le nyams na/ yon tan gyi 'char sgo 'gags pa yin pas/ thabs dang ldan pa rnams kyis rten ma nyams par bya'o// rten la yang rigs gsum ste/ tha mal gyi rten ni/ chang btsags kyi sbang ma dang 'dra ste/ rten nyams pa ni lus la nus pa med pa yin no// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa rnams ni/

rten ma nyams pa'i lus nus ldan du gnas kyang*/ sa bon snod du lus pa'am/ ri dwags kyi rtsi dang 'dra ste/ thabs khyad par can dang mi ldan pas yon tan skye bar mi nus so// gsang sngags thabs khyad par can dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag rnams ni/ rten nus mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ ljon shing sa la btsugs nas chu lud bran pa lta bu'o// de yang sa gzhi dang 'dra ba ni phyag rgya mtshan ldan no// ljon shing gi rtsa ba 'bras bu'i 'bras bu lta bu ni thig le'o// chu lud bran pa lta bu ni thig le bzhu btul byed pa'o// shing las sdong po dang*/ yal ga las me tog dang 'bras bu rgyas pa lta bu ni thig le las su rung ba la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'o// de ltar thig le gzung ba'i thabs la gnyis te/ chags lam pa las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas gzung ba dang*/ grol lam (194)pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dbang dang byin brlabs kyis rgyud smin par byas la bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ yab yum lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ brtse ba dang gdung ba'i sgo nas rtsa'i nus pa rgyas par byas la// de nas dal bus snyoms par 'jug cing thig le rim pas phab la/ bde stong gi nyams la gnas par bya/ mthar bde ba shin tu rgyas nas/ thig le nyams su nye ba na/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ rgyu zhabs rgal pa la sbyar nas hūm̐ zhes dbu ma'i nang nas yar drag tu drangs nas/ bde chen gnas su lhan gyis bskyal lo// shin tu thig le rgyas nas mi thub nas ma zin par 'chor na/ rtsa dgag pa'i sbyor ba la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar rtsa nus ldan gyi steng du/ thig le phab nas bde ba la stong pas rgyas btab cing bde stong gi nyams yang nas yang du spar shing*/ mjug rdo rje skyil krung gis steng 'og rlung lan gsum gcud la bor la/

thig le gnas su khyab par dgram/ rjes la lus sems bcos med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag go /gnyis pa grol lam pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa ni/ rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis yi dam lha yab yum gyi rnam pa can du gsal bar bskyed la/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ dal bus snyoms 'jug byed par bsam zhing*/ lag pa'i 'du byed kyis thig le phab/ bde ba'i ro rlod pa dang*/ stong pas rgyas btab/ rtsa nus ldan gyi steng du thig le pheb pa'i tshe/ bde stong gi nyams la ma yengs par byas la/ 'og rlung 'then la hūm̐ gis drag tu drang*/ mig nam mkha' la bgrad/ lus drag tu bsgrim/ des kyang ma zin na rtsa dgag pa'i sbyor ba bya/ de nas sngar bzhin du thig le dgram pa dang*/ rjes ma bcos par 'jog pa (195)rnams bya'o// lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i tshig /chos skor dgu yi gdams pa 'di// tai lo zhes bya'i rnal 'byor pas// tshangs pa'i gsungs rang yi ger btab// 'phri bsnan med pa gnad kyi gsang*// gcig brgyud dag tu gdams pa yin// yang dag pa'i gdams pa zab// / rgya gar gyi grub thob te phu pa gsang sngags sdong po la/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa ras chung rdo rje grags pas zhus shing bod du spyan drangs pa'o// (196)
